topic: 限时写作：图表概述与关键比较
grammarFocus: 趋势、比较、比例、时态与数据句的准确性。
title: Timed Writing: Chart Overview and Key Comparisons
prompt: In many cities, the number of people using public transport has fallen while private car use has risen, and this shift has created serious congestion and pollution problems. Some people believe that making public transport free is the best way to reverse this trend, while others argue that improving the quality and reliability of public transport is more important than lowering its price. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on which approach is more likely to reduce private car use. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习（建议40分钟）。请先花约5分钟审题并列出双方观点及你自己的立场，再用约30分钟完成不少于250词的完整议论文，最后留约5分钟检查。注意：题目要求讨论“免费公共交通”和“提升公共交通质量与可靠性”两种观点，并明确给出你認為哪种方式更能减少私家车使用；两个观点都必须充分展开，不能只写一方。写作时请用具体但假设性的例子支持论点，避免堆砌数据。所有情景与数据均为模拟练习材料，并非官方雅思试题，请勿将其视为真实考试内容。
